legal.noGo: Patchwork remains operationally NO-GO. These drafts require legal and product-owner approval before publication as effective terms.
legal.termsSummary: Patchwork is peer-to-peer mutual-aid coordination, not an emergency, professional, fulfillment, or identity-guarantee service.
legal.terms1: You must be at least 18 and accept the current policy version before protected actions.
legal.terms2: Public aid, volunteer, and directory records can federate through AT Protocol; private offers, connections, evidence, and attachments do not.
legal.terms3: Private chat is limited to active accepted connections and current group-room members. Messages are server-readable, are not end-to-end encrypted, and are retained for up to 365 days.
legal.terms4: Synthetic records are fictional. Public-source organization references do not imply participation or endorsement.
legal.privacySummary: Patchwork separates public AT records from private operational state and minimizes location, attachment, notification, and moderation data.
legal.privacy1: Personal and volunteer locations are public only at 1 km precision or coarser.
legal.privacy2: Exact personal coordinates move only over a freshly consented encrypted peer channel and are not persisted by Patchwork.
legal.privacy3: A verified, non-confidential resource address is public only after separate moderator approval.
legal.privacy4: Private attachments are scanned and transformed; clean access is authenticated and short-lived.
legal.privacy5: Exports omit credentials, file bodies, signed URLs, third-party casework, and exact personal coordinates.
legal.guidelinesSummary: Use Patchwork in good faith, protect privacy, and report fraud, harassment, discrimination, illegal activity, or attempts to bypass safety controls.
legal.guidelines1: Never publish another person’s private contact or exact-location information.
legal.guidelines2: Moderators can delist, suspend visibility, restore content, and review appeals with an audit trail.
legal.guidelines3: The report-review aim is two business days on a best-effort basis; it is not an emergency response or guaranteed service level.
legal.guidelines4: Use emergency and professional services outside Patchwork when the situation requires them.
